verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm, but it ships client-facing technology (a trademark extranet, AI tools, and Fenwick Labs 'web services'), so asking whether it offers programmatic access is a fair question. The pack contains no evidence of a public API, API versioning or a deprecation policy. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
